name: apidoc-command
description: Analyze an OpenAPI controller and DTOs to generate an API spec HTML and register it in apiService core.js

interface.shortDescription: Generate an API spec HTML from a controller and register it in apiService.
interface.longDescription: Provides a skill that reads an OpenAPI controller and its response DTOs, clones the embedded-font head of an existing spec HTML template, and writes a consistent API specification HTML under docs/api/, then registers the download mapping in apiService core.js.
defaultPrompt: Use apidoc-command to document the latest controller.
